spans.s: pātha (IE 8-6; IA 11), a land measure regarded as equal to 240 square feet.
pathaka (IE 8-4; EI 4, 23, 27; CII 3, 4; LP), a group of villages; a territorial division like a Parganā of later days.
Pathakīyaka (LP), explained as one who collects the road-tax [for the maintenance of the road] or the transit tax. But cf. pathaka also.
pāthi (IA 15), a territorial unit; same as pathaka.
